run_dedup_pipeline: run the deduplication pipeline on a dataset by providing dataset name and base directory via CLI
get_pairs_byterange: parse a byterange file to extract duplicate byte range pairs from deduplication output
get_bytes_from_pairs: extract byte slices from raw data using left and right byte range pairs
get_doc_id_by_position: look up the document ID for a given byte position using binary search on position mappings
add_duplication_info_to_dataset: map duplication metadata including dup ratio, pairs, repetitions, and clusters onto each dataset example
